title: Circular
description: Vanilla resorspack, make a most beaty the base Vanilla textures
body:
Interesting resourspack - change a block like stone, trees, and other popular block, this resourspack is targeting on a atmospheric not loosing vanilla gameplay. Trying to make a gameplay more cartoonish, warm, without losing much of its vanilla essence.

Adds greater texture and clarity to the main textures. This texture pack was created entirely from the author's imagination and vision.
